statements.status_notes: GHSA-jh2m-fhpj-3vr7 (RUSTSEC-2026-0486): from rustix 1.0.0 to before 1.1.6 the Buffer-based getxattr, lgetxattr, fgetxattr, listxattr, llistxattr and flistxattr wrappers treat the size returned by a zero-size query as initialized output, which safe callers can turn into a panic or undefined behaviour. Fixed in rustix 1.1.6 by https://github.com/bytecodealliance/rustix/commit/8e6aaa6713d2bb64b1fdd8c472e3a32a10a76d70: https://github.com/bytecodealliance/rustix/security/advisories/GHSA-jh2m-fhpj-3vr7, https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0486.html. Read all 94 uv packages in the DHI Debian repository as of 2026-11-27: every published build, 0.11.22-0 to the current 0.13.10-4, on amd64 and arm64 (47 per architecture), each checked against the checksum in the package index; no debug-symbol packages are listed for this source. Each package holds two dynamically linked ELF programs, /usr/bin/uv and /usr/bin/uvx, plus shell completions, man pages and documentation; no package holds a static archive, PE or Mach-O file. For each program I read the crate list that cargo-auditable embeds and searched the program for the crates' source paths. The list of /usr/bin/uv names rustix 1.1.4 in 0.11.22-0 to 0.13.1-0 (with rustix 0.38.44, which is not affected, also listed in 0.11.26-0 to 0.12.1-0), rustix 1.1.5 in 0.13.2-0 to 0.13.7-2, and rustix 1.1.6 in every build from 0.13.7-3 on, and the rustix 1.x source paths compiled into /usr/bin/uv name the same version. /usr/bin/uvx is a small launcher that runs uv: its embedded list names the same crates, but in no build does it contain rustix source paths, while the same search finds other crates' paths (gimli, miniz_oxide) in it and finds rustix paths in /usr/bin/uv. Every build before 0.13.7-3 ships an affected rustix 1.x and every build from 0.13.7-3 on ships 1.1.6.
